description: This file defines the PaymentService interface, which declares methods for processing payments, refunds, configuration management, validation, and retrieval of payment modules and methods within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: PaymentService
classes.description: Interface for handling payment-related operations including processing, configuration, validation, and retrieval of payment modules and methods.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Gets the configured payment modules for a store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes a payment transaction for a customer, store, shopping cart items, and an order.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a specific order and customer.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module based on payment type (e.g., CREDITCARD).

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module based on a payment code (e.g., paypal).

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the configuration for a payment module.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates credit card number and details.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a specific payment module.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Processes capture payment for an order.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Gets accepted payment methods for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Retrieves a PaymentModule based on a payment code.
